note: Owner-maintained crisis and support directory (plan v3 W6/W8; directory audit plan G, verified 2026-11-07). Every entry keeps source + lastVerifiedAt current: CrisisResourcesReleaseTest fails the build otherwise. Fields the official source did not state are empty and are omitted on screen, never guessed. Do not add a 24/7 or free claim that the source does not state.

resources.name: Emergency services
resources.description: Police, ambulance, and fire. Call 999 or 112 if you are in immediate danger.
resources.source: Communications Authority of Kenya, Telecommunication Numbering Plan, May 2025 — https://www.ca.go.ke
resources.limitations: 112 is also official; it is attributed variously to Kenya Police and the National Ambulance Dispatch Centre.

resources.name: Kenya Red Cross — Mental Health Hotline
resources.description: Toll-free emotional support and psychosocial counselling.
resources.hours: Reported 24/7; the current homepage does not list 1199
resources.limitations: 1199 is also a general emergency line. The 24/7 mental-health claim is not on the current homepage; re-check before release.

resources.name: Befrienders Kenya
resources.description: Confidential emotional support by phone, SMS, and WhatsApp. Not 24/7.
resources.hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm, per directory listings
resources.cost: Free volunteer service; not explicitly stated
resources.limitations: The official website is currently unavailable, and one directory shows conflicting hours. Do not present this as 24/7.

resources.name: One2One 1190 (LVCT Health)
resources.limitations: Not a Ministry of Health line; 1190 is operated by LVCT Health. Cost and languages are not stated officially.

resources.name: Niskize
resources.cost: Not stated; 0900 numbers may be charged
resources.limitations: Crisis support is not explicitly stated. Cost is not stated.

resources.name: Gambling Regulatory Authority — self-exclusion
resources.description: The official Kenyan self-exclusion process. It cannot be ended early.
resources.source: https://gra.go.ke/self-exclusion-process/; Gambling Control (Conduct of Gambling Operations) Regulations, 2026
resources.eligibility: Exclusion runs 6 months to 5 years and cannot be ended early
resources.limitations: The page still carries BCLB branding and a BCLB email (support@bclb.go.ke). Verify contact details before sending personal documents. On the check date the site presented an incomplete TLS chain and injected SEO spam links.

resources.name: Gamblers Anonymous Kenya
resources.description: Fellowship meetings in Nairobi and Murang'a.
resources.source: Official GA international meeting search, country = Kenya
resources.hours: Nairobi: Saturday 5:00pm. Murang'a: Saturday and Sunday 6:30pm.
resources.cost: No fee stated; groups are self-supporting
resources.eligibility: The Nairobi meeting is closed: attendees must have a desire to stop gambling.
resources.limitations: Meeting details change; confirm before attending. Nairobi: 02 Koinange St. Murang'a listing note: Gamblers Addiction and Recovery Kenya. GA international service office: +1 909 931 9056.

resources.name: SMART Recovery
resources.description: Free self-management meetings for addictive behaviours, including a Nairobi online meeting.
resources.source: Official SMART Recovery Global meeting page #1159
resources.hours: Nairobi online meeting #1159: Saturdays 3:00-4:30pm in the device time zone; the calendar metadata shows 18:00-19:30 Africa/Nairobi instead.
resources.limitations: The displayed time and calendar metadata conflict; confirm in the meeting finder. The join link comes from the facilitator or the meeting notes.

resources.name: Find A Helpline
resources.description: Verified helplines in 175+ countries, by topic.
resources.limitations: A directory, not a helpline. Listings are maintained by the directory, not by MyExodus.

resources.name: Sexaholics Anonymous
resources.description: International fellowship for compulsive sexual behaviour, with phone and online meetings.
resources.hours: Office weekdays 8am-4pm Central; phone meetings daily
resources.limitations: No verified current Kenya in-person meeting. SA defines sobriety specifically (married: no sex outside a marriage between a man and a woman; unmarried: no sex of any kind). International dial-in from Kenya is not confirmed. US toll-free: 866-424-8777.

resources.name: Gaming Addicts Anonymous
resources.description: International fellowship for compulsive gaming, with daily online and phone meetings.
resources.source: Official GAA site and online-meetings page
resources.hours: Daily online meetings; schedule on the site
resources.limitations: International dial-in numbers include the US, Canada, the Netherlands, the UK, and Australia. Helpline: helpline@gaais.org. Zoom access help: zoomaccess@gaais.org.

resources.name: NACADA
resources.description: Alcohol and drug use support. This service is not for gambling, porn, or gaming.
resources.limitations: Scope is alcohol and drugs. Do not present it as a gambling, porn, or gaming service. NSSF Building Block A, 18th Floor.

resources.name: Mathari National Teaching and Referral Hospital
resources.description: Public psychiatric hospital: outpatient, inpatient, and telemental health.
resources.hours: General and outpatient psychiatric services 24/7; child clinic Wednesday 8am-1pm
resources.limitations: A referral hospital, not a helpline. Use for professional help, not as a crisis line.

resources.name: Kenya Counselling and Psychological Association
resources.description: Professional body for counsellors and psychologists; contact for practitioner referrals.
resources.limitations: No verified online practitioner search; contact the association. AGIP House, 4th Floor, Room 422, Haile Sellasie Avenue, Nairobi.

resources.name: Kenya Psychological Association
resources.limitations: No public practitioner finder verified. A professional body, not a service.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988 for free, confidential support.
resources.limitations: US only. Not a Kenya service.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text HOME to 741741 to reach a crisis counsellor by text.
resources.cost: Free; message and data rates may apply
resources.limitations: US line listed here. The service also lists Canada, the UK, and Ireland numbers; they are not included in this entry.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free treatment referral and information for mental health and substance use.
resources.limitations: A referral service, not counselling. US only. TTY: 1-800-487-4889.
